decisions.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
decisions.reason: A concurrent agent retired this row into 'Dumbbell Row' (EL-21/EL-23) mid-pass; it is no longer a live corpus row, so the null instance no longer exists. Had it remained live, the intended resolution was axialLoad: false, matching the established 'Dumbbell Row' precedent in CURATED_DEMANDS (bench-supported single-arm row, torso braced, no spinal load) — confirmed by this row's own cue: 'Rest one knee and hand on a bench'.

leastConfident: Machine Curl / Machine Tricep Extension unilateralLoadable: cue text says 'gripping the handles' (plural), which is genuinely ambiguous between two independent pivots and a single rigid bar with two grip zones; left unknown rather than guessed.

Plate-Loaded Overhead Extension / Plate-Loaded Rear Delt unilateralLoadable: same plate-loaded branding as the resolved chest/shoulder press rows, but neither cue carries the 'one side leads' evidence those presses have, and isolation plate-loaded machines are less consistently independent-arm than the compound press/row family; left unknown rather than extending the press-family precedent without direct evidence.

Plate-Loaded Decline Press / Plate-Loaded Shoulder Press unilateralLoadable: resolved true by analogy to sibling Plate-Loaded Chest Press/Incline Press rows in the same apparatus family, but these two rows' own cues lack the explicit 'one side leads' fault line the siblings have.
